roadtrip_g10.notes: First 10 gates of Roadtrip. The pilot stops itself after its 10th self-reported pass (gate_pilot.max_gates=10). ~3.2 min of flight at baseline (gate 10 at 189 s in logs/20261025_130028).

roadtrip_full.game_menu: Single player > Race > Uncrashed > Roadtrip 'Follow the road' (2nd row) > Free race
roadtrip_full.notes: Whole race. 28 is config race.gates and is NOT the end of the course. Checked 2026-10-26 from view frames: in the pre-event 'finish' (logs/20261025_130028, ~510-516 s) and in v0 baseline attempts 20261026_124224_2212_01 and _03, the pilot's 28th self-counted pass is followed by a gate at a left bend, with a magenta (later) gate still on the course to the left. The pilot crosses that gate, flies straight on into the field, and stops with 'no next gate after crossing' while the race clock keeps running. With that fixed (v2, 2026-10-26) two attempts reached 31 and 32 self-counted passes and still saw later (magenta) gates ahead, clock running at 9:22. Validation attempt 20261026_154118_5905_04 (v3 + random-arm candidate 8) reached 53 self-counted passes and was still flying when duration_s 900 ended it: race clock 15:13 and running, Laps 1/1, many magenta gates still ahead (view/922.64). Real gate count unknown, well over 53; at that speed 900 s is not enough to finish. First finish 2026-10-26 (see finish_definition): the x5/x7 speed settings, 63 self-counted gates in 9:29.874 race time.
roadtrip_full.finish_definition: The game shows a Results screen: 'Results <race time>', the pilot's name and time, 'Personal best', Gold 1:00 / Silver 1:10 / Bronze 1:20, 'PRESS RESET TO RETRY', Restart / Free flight buttons. The screen is static, so the window capture stops delivering frames (runner: 'no frame from the game window'). First finish 2026-10-26 ~20:32: x7 speed-experiment flight 20261026_202231_57c7_01 (training), 63 self-counted gates, race time 9:29.874, confirmed by the user watching ('you managed to beat the game ... despite 2 crashes'); screenshot hackathon/runs/evidence/first_finish_results_9-29-874.png
